summary.headline: Aspect Types and Ephemeris Abbreviations
summary.text: Discussion of trine and square aspects, including shared sign boundaries, ephemeris abbreviations for combined aspects, antiscion, apogee, ascendant, conjunction, and opposition. The text begins explaining how benefic or malefic effects arise before a planet reaches an exact aspect or conjunction with another planet or the Moon’s nodes.
